second_toolchain.why: it is the compiler Jak 2 and Jak 3 were built with, so it is the one that can check a source against a second game
second_toolchain.status: built from the SDK's own sources, same recipe as the 2.7.0 one

flags.status: per link unit, not global: two different sets reproduce the target
notes: -mno-save-restore-tocbase is what removes the TOC base from the frame; without it the compiler keeps a back chain the retail code does not have.

the optimisation level is a property of the file, not of the build: the function at 0x10200 is reproduced at -O1 (or at -O2 with the second scheduler off), while the functions at 0x6FA4F8, 0x6FA6D0 and 0x6E1C78 need -O2 with the second scheduler on.  No single set of options reproduces all four, so the flags belong to the hypothesis about the source, not to the project.
